host.description: aTrust OpenAPI base URL, for example https://atrust.example.com:4433.

maxResponseBytes.description: Maximum upstream response size in bytes.

skipTlsVerify.description: Skip TLS certificate verification for private aTrust deployments.

lang.description: Default OpenAPI lang query value for endpoints that support it.

timestampOffsetSeconds.description: Seconds added to the signing timestamp. Use only when the aTrust appliance clock validation is offset from real Unix time.

headers.description: Extra HTTP headers appended to upstream requests.
